column1: # build/tlib-policy.tsv -- tlib version policy. Read by tools/layer-api.cx --bump.
# key<TAB>value. `stable` is the global default (yes|no); a row `PKG<TAB>yes|no` overrides it for one package.
# stable=no (PRE-STABLE): --bump never raises X or Y; any change is a Z bump inside the same X.Y; api_sha and the content sha still change.
# stable=yes: unchanged -> Z, additive -> Y, breaking -> X. Declare a package stable by flipping its row (or the global row) to yes.
# A missing file means stable=yes (fixtures). Ledger: TLIB-PRESTABLE-POLICY.
